Pure value-type kernel module. No I/O, no network, no secrets, no unsafe. partition_key is &str — caller-owned, trimmed before validation. No injection surface. No serde/serialisation surface in this delta.

Directly implements M06-P04-IP-002 analytics.streaming.subscribe substrate: provider-neutral StreamingPartitionStrategy enum governs shard placement without encoding adapter specifics. Follows Directive 4 (no provider deps outside adapter crates).

New module in existing oya-cloud-data-kernel. No new crate scaffold, no new workspace deps, std-only. pub mod + pub use re-export from crate root follows existing DataServiceKind/DataServicePlan pattern in same crate. Mirrors M06-P03 merge-variant pattern (PR #60-#96).
